an6.56:1.1: Tena kho pana samayena āyasmā Phagguno ābādhiko hoti dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
an6.56:1.2: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an6.56:1.4: sādhu bhante Bhagavā yen' āyasmā Phagguno ten' upasaṅkamatu anukampaṃ upādāyā' ti.
an6.56:1.6: Atha kho Bhagavā sāyaṇhasamayaṃ paṭisallānā vuṭṭhito yen' āyasmā Phagguno ten' upasaṅkami.
an6.56:1.7: Addasā kho āyasmā Phagguno Bhagavantaṃ dūrato 'va āgacchantaṃ,
an6.56:1.9: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Phaggunaṃ etad avoca
an6.56:1.10: ‘alaṃ Phagguna, mā tvaṃ mañcake samañco pi.
an6.56:1.11: Sant'imāni āsanāni pure paññattāni, tatthāhaṃ nisīdissāmī' ti.
an6.56:1.13: Nisajja kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Phaggunaṃ etad avoca
an6.56:2.1: ‘kacci te Phagguna khamanīyaṃ, kacci yāpanīyaṃ, kacci dukkhā vedanā paṭikkamanti no abhikkamanti, paṭikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no abhikkamo' ti?
an6.56:2.2: ‘Na me bhante khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ, bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti, abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo.
an6.56:3.1: Seyyathā pi bhante balavā puriso tiṇhena sikharena muddhānaṃ abhimattheyya, evam eva kho me bhante adhimattā vātā muddhānaṃ hananti;
an6.56:3.2: na me bhante khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ, bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti, abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo.
an6.56:4.1: Seyyathā pi bhante balavā puriso daḷhena varattakkhaṇḍena sīse sīsaveṭhanaṃ dadeyya, evam eva kho me bhante adhimattā sīse sīsavedanā;
an6.56:4.2: na me bhante khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ, bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti, abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo.
an6.56:5.1: Seyyathā pi bhante dakkho goghātako vā goghātakantevāsī vā tiṇhena govikantanena kucchiṃ parikanteyya, evam eva kho me bhante adhimattā vātā kucchiṃ parikantanti;
an6.56:5.2: na me bhante khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ, bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkamanti no paṭikkamanti, abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo.
an6.56:6.1: Seyyathā pi bhante dve balavanto purisā dubbalataraṃ purisaṃ nānābāhāsu gahetvā aṅgārakāsuyā santāpeyyuṃ paritāpeyyuṃ, evam eva kho bhante adhimatto kāyasmiṃ ḍāho;
an6.56:6.2: na me bhante khamanīyaṃ, na yāpanīyaṃ, bāḷhā me dukkhā vedanā abhikkhamanti no paṭikkamanti, abhikkamosānaṃ paññāyati no paṭikkamo' ti.
an6.56:6.3: Atha kho Bhagavā āyasmantaṃ Phaggunaṃ dhammiyā kathāya sandassetvā samādapetvā samuttejetvā sampahaṃsetvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi. 2.
an6.56:7.1: Atha kho āyasmā Phagguno acirapakkantassa Bhagavato kālam akāsi.
an6.56:7.2: Tamhi c'assa samaye maraṇakāle indriyāni vippasīdiṃsu.
an6.56:7.3: Atha kho āyasmā Ānando yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Ānando Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca
an6.56:7.4: ‘āyasmā bhante Phagguno acirapakkantassa Bhagavato kālam akāsi;
an6.56:7.5: tamhi c'assa samaye maraṇakāle indriyāni vippasīdiṃsū' ti.
an6.56:8.1: Kiṃ h' Ānanda Phaggunassa bhikkhuno indriyāni na vippasīdissanti?
an6.56:8.2: Phaggunassa Ānanda bhikkhuno pañcahi orambhāgiyehi saṃyojanehi cittaṃ avimuttaṃ ahosi.
an6.56:8.3: Tassa taṃ dhammadesanaṃ sutvā pañcahi orambhāgiyehi saṃyojanehi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ.
an6.56:9.1: Cha yime Ānanda ānisaṃsā kālena dhammasavane kālena atthupaparikkhāya.
an6.56:9.3: Idh' Ānanda bhikkhuno pañcahi orambhāgiyehi saṃyojanehi cittaṃ avimuttaṃ hoti.
an6.56:9.4: So tamhi samaye maraṇakāle labhati Tathāgataṃ dassanāya.
an6.56:9.5: Tassa Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
an6.56:9.6: Tassa taṃ dhammadesanaṃ sutvā pañcahi orambhāgiyehi saṃyojanehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
an6.56:9.7: Ayaṃ Ānanda paṭhamo ānisaṃso kālena dhammasavane. 4.
an6.56:10.1: Puna ca paraṃ Ānanda bhikkhuno pañcahi orambhāgiyehi saṃyojanehi cittaṃ avimuttaṃ hoti.
an6.56:10.2: So tamhi samaye maraṇakāle na h'eva kho labhati Tathāgataṃ dassanāya, api ca kho Tathāgatasāvakaṃ labhati dassanāya.
an6.56:10.3: Tassa Tathāgatasāvako dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ pariyosānakalyāṇaṃ sātthaṃ savyañjanaṃ kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
an6.56:10.4: Tassa taṃ dhammadesanaṃ sutvā pañcahi orambhāgiyehi saṃyojanehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
an6.56:10.5: Ayaṃ Ānanda dutiyo ānisaṃso kālena dhammasavane. 5.
an6.56:11.1: Puna ca paraṃ Ānanda bhikkhuno pañcahi orambhāgiyehi saṃyojanehi cittaṃ avimuttaṃ hoti.
an6.56:11.2: So tamhi samaye maraṇakāle na h'eva kho labhati Tathāgataṃ dassanāya, na pi Tathāgatasāvakaṃ labhati dassanāya,
an6.56:11.3: api ca kho yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti manasānupekkhati.
an6.56:11.4: Tassa yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakkayato anuvicārayato manasānupekkhato pañcahi orambhāgiyehi saṃyojanehi cittaṃ vimuccati.
an6.56:11.5: Ayaṃ Ānanda tatiyo ānisaṃso kālena atthupaparikkhāya. 6.
an6.56:12.1: Idh' Ānanda bhikkhuno pañcahi orambhāgiyehi saṃyojanehi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti, anuttare ca kho upadhisaṃkhaye cittaṃ avimuttaṃ hoti.
an6.56:12.2: So tamhi samaye maraṇakāle labhati Tathāgataṃ dassanāya.
an6.56:12.3: Tassa Tathāgato dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ majjhe kalyāṇaṃ . . . pe . . . brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
an6.56:12.4: Tassa taṃ dhammadesanaṃ sutvā anuttare upadhisaṃkhaye cittaṃ vimuccati.
an6.56:12.5: Ayaṃ Ānanda catuttho ānisaṃso kālena dhammasavane. 7.
an6.56:13.1: Puna ca paraṃ Ānanda bhikkhuno pañcahi orambhāgiyehi saṃyojanehi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti, anuttare ca kho upadhisaṃkhaye cittaṃ avimuttaṃ hoti.
an6.56:13.2: So tamhi samaye maraṇakāle na h'eva kho labhati Tathāgataṃ dassanāya, api ca kho Tathāgatasāvakaṃ labhati dassanāya.
an6.56:13.3: Tassa Tathāgatasāvako dhammaṃ deseti ādikalyāṇaṃ . . . pe . . . parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ pakāseti.
an6.56:13.4: Tassa taṃ dhammadesanaṃ sutvā anuttare upadhisaṃkhaye cittaṃ vimuccati.
an6.56:13.5: Ayaṃ Ānanda pañcamo ānisaṃso kālena dhammasavane. 8.
an6.56:14.1: Puna ca paraṃ Ānanda bhikkhuno pañcahi orambhāgiyehi saṃyojanehi cittaṃ vimuttaṃ hoti, anuttare ca kho upadhisaṃkhaye cittaṃ avimuttaṃ hoti.
an6.56:14.2: So tamhi samaye maraṇakāle na h'eva kho labhati Tathāgataṃ dassanāya, na pi Tathāgatasāvakaṃ labhati dassanāya,
an6.56:14.3: api ca kho yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakketi anuvicāreti manasānupekkhati.
an6.56:14.4: Tassa yathāsutaṃ yathāpariyattaṃ dhammaṃ cetasā anuvitakkayato anuvicārayato manasānupekkhato anuttare upadhisaṃkhaye cittaṃ vimuccati.
an6.56:14.5: Ayaṃ Ānanda chaṭṭho ānisaṃso kālena atthupaparikkhāya.
an6.56:15.1: Ime kho Ānanda cha ānisaṃsā kālena dhammasavane kālena atthupaparikkhāyā
